Definition: Jehozabad, the name of three Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Jehozabad is the name of three Israelites, a captain, a porter and a servant of Joash. In 2 Kings 12:21, Jehozabad the son of Shomer. The fuller story is told on the Jehozabad, Son of Shomer profile in Biblical People.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Jehozabad shows me God keeps His promises across generations, even through flawed families.
